source: data/graph/graph.graphml (run 1's graph; this stage does not rebuild it)
edge_version_note: Both versions describe the SAME node set; only edges of the fallback type differ. Reading them apart is the point: a large gap says the reported topology is carried by the extractor's unlabelled relations, and must be stated wherever a structural descriptor is quoted.

market_layer.status_rule: n_market_edges < 30 => no significance test may be run on this layer and none of its numbers may enter an abstract (plan v2 §5, threshold pre-registered at 30 before this stage was written)

synthesis_layer.reading_rule: n_distinct_conditions_kept is what the ARTIFACT contains; the sampling figure (1,200 draws over 710 distinct conditions, DP-5) describes the DRAW and cannot be recovered from this file. The kept count must be <= the sampled distinct count; quoting one as the other is a claim about a different object.
